title: Municipal Councils And Urban Councils (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE MUNICIPAL COUNCILS ORDINANCE AND THE URBAN COUNCILS ORDINANCE.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title and date of operation.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Municipal Councils and date of Urban Councils (Amendment) Act, No. 10 of 1981, and shall operation. come into operation on such date as the Minister may appoint by Order published in the Gazette.

body.heading: AMENDMENTS TO THE MUNICIPAL COUNCILS ORDINANCE

children.heading: Amendment of section 230 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance
children.raw_text: 2. Section 230 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance, as amended by Acts Nos. 8 of 1967 and 57 of 1979, is hereby further amended by the insertion immediately after subsection (1A) of that section of the following new subsections: " (IAA) In pursuance of the powers under subsection (1) the Council may impose a higher rate on premises used for business or commercial purposes.
